claude.sample_unit: ICU stays (52,028 MIMIC-IV development; 114,060 eICU external validation)

links.outcome: Calibration of ICU mortality model on external eICU data versus internal MIMIC-IV data
links.effect: Internal calibration near-ideal (slope 0.982; intercept 0.001); external validation showed systematic risk overestimation (intercept -0.678); external AUROC 0.819 vs internal 0.847.
links.quote: Internal calibration was near-ideal (slope 0.982; intercept 0.001), whereas external validation revealed systematic risk overestimation (intercept − 0.678) attributable to prevalence-driven label shift.

links.outcome: Expected calibration error after intercept-only recalibration on external data
links.effect: An intercept-only adjustment reduced ECE by 26%.
links.quote: An intercept-only adjustment reduced ECE by 26%.

links.outcome: AUROC of XGBoost model versus APACHE score benchmark
links.effect: The model outperformed APACHE (AUROC 0.817 vs. 0.795; p < 0.001).
links.quote: The model outperformed APACHE (AUROC 0.817 vs. 0.795; p < 0.001).
